project.name: Ashburton Tagalog — New Congregation Recommendation
project.working_arrangement: Ashburton Tagalog group under the Ashburton host body of elders
project.current_direction: Both S-51 forms—the proposed Ashburton Tagalog congregation and the Ashburton host congregation—have been sent to the circuit overseer. S-50 through par. 5 has been confirmed; par. 6 remains pending because branch approval and start instructions have not yet been received.
project.next_action: Wait for the circuit overseer’s next direction and, under S-50 par. 6, the branch office’s approval letter. Do not begin functioning or assume a start date before that letter.

forms.title: Congregation Application/Information — proposed congregation
forms.purpose: Records the proposed congregation’s complete name, projected publishers and pioneers, appointed men, reasons, directly involved congregations, proposed start and circuit/section.
forms.timing: Completed and sent to the circuit overseer; points 1–8 apply and the new congregation number remains blank.
forms.owner: Host body of elders and circuit overseer
forms.notes: The signed proposed-congregation S-51 was sent to the circuit overseer on 9 August 2026; further action depends on his or the branch office’s direction.

forms.title: Congregation Application/Information — Ashburton host congregation
forms.purpose: Records the existing host congregation’s identity and projected post-formation points 2–4.
forms.timing: Specifically requested by the circuit overseer, completed, and sent to him.
forms.notes: The Ashburton host-congregation S-51 has been sent to the circuit overseer. The exact send date is not recorded locally.

forms.title: Coordinator/Secretary Change of Address
forms.purpose: Identifies the coordinator and secretary and provides their contact/address information.
required_for: any existing congregation whose coordinator or secretary changes
forms.timing: Part of the eventual recommendation package unless the circuit overseer directs otherwise.
forms.notes: Proposed coordinator and secretary require confirmation.

forms.title: Kingdom Hall Information
forms.purpose: Records the meeting place and its congregation-use arrangement.
required_for: existing congregations whose Kingdom Hall information changes
forms.timing: Part of the eventual recommendation package unless the circuit overseer directs otherwise.
forms.notes: The Ashburton Kingdom Hall address is known; the formal use arrangement still needs completion.

forms.title: Periodical Request
forms.purpose: Establishes periodical and Life and Ministry Meeting Workbook quantities.
forms.timing: May be included with the recommendation or entered on jw.org after approval when directed.
forms.notes: This is the only listed item for which S-50 explicitly offers an after-approval alternative.

forms.title: Shipping Information
forms.purpose: Establishes shipping address and the Kingdom Hall Literature Group arrangement.
required_for: ship-to congregation at the meeting hall
forms.timing: Part of the eventual recommendation package unless the circuit overseer directs otherwise.
forms.notes: Required even when shipments normally go to a Regional Literature Depot.

forms.title: Territory Adjustment Request
forms.purpose: Documents proposed territory assignment and affected boundary adjustments.
required_for: each existing congregation whose boundaries are affected
forms.timing: Part of the eventual recommendation package unless the circuit overseer directs otherwise.
forms.owner: Circuit overseer and affected bodies of elders
forms.notes: Final language-territory boundaries and directly affected congregations require confirmation.

requirements.requirement: A significant language-dependent population lives near the Kingdom Hall, without excessive travel or search work.
evidence: 1,605 Filipino people in Ashburton District in 2023 Census data cited in the email draft
2.17% of Ashburton District residents able to speak Tagalog in cited 2023 Census language data
Approximately 3,000 Filipinos in Mid Canterbury reported as an informed local estimate
requirements.notes: Confirmed in the S-50 review. Preserve the official district figure and the wider-area estimate as different measures.

requirements.requirement: Publishers depend on the language for spiritual food or language-dependent Bible students attend and progress toward baptism.
evidence: 35 publishers listed in the August proposal
46 Bible studies printed in the June S-303
requirements.notes: Confirmed in the S-50 review. The reporting date for the separate figure of 34 progressive studies remains a data-provenance question, not an S-50 blocker.

requirements.requirement: A solid core of spiritually mature publishers is fluent in the language.
evidence: 31 active publishers in the August proposal
10 regular pioneers in the August proposal

requirements.requirement: Enough appointed men, including at least one elder, can provide shepherding, handle meeting parts and lead the ministry; most are fluent.
evidence: 5 elders and 2 ministerial servants printed in the August proposal
The June S-303 describes host-congregation strain and shepherding/training difficulty
requirements.notes: Confirmed in the S-50 review; the supporting counts remain recorded as evidence.

requirements.requirement: The congregation can conduct all weekly meetings locally without depending on JW Stream.
evidence: June S-303: weekend meetings every week
June S-303: full Tagalog midweek meeting once monthly and Tagalog CLAM twice monthly

requirements.requirement: The study Watchtower and Life and Ministry Meeting Workbook are available in Tagalog or another language in which most publishers are literate.
A Kingdom Hall or another appropriate meeting place is available.
requirements.notes: Confirmed in the S-50 review; the known meeting-place address remains recorded as evidence.

requirements.requirement: Each publisher or family head freely decides which congregation the family will attend; no one is pressured.
The circuit overseer verifies the accurately prepared recommendation information before sending it to the Service Department.
evidence: Proposed-congregation S-51 received and reviewed by the circuit overseer
Ashburton host-congregation S-51 sent to the circuit overseer
requirements.notes: Confirmed in the S-50 review. Both requested S-51 forms have been sent; remaining forms should follow current direction.

requirements.requirement: Wait for branch approval and use the start date and further instructions in the approval letter.
requirements.notes: Awaiting the branch office’s approval decision, official start date, and further instructions. A proposed date is not approval to begin functioning.
